entries.title: Set BitLocker to encrypt with XTS-AES-256
entries.description: Sets the BitLocker Group Policy so operating-system, fixed-data and removable-data drives are encrypted with XTS-AES-256 instead of the XTS-AES-128 default. Only affects volumes encrypted after the policy is applied.
entries.rationale: XTS-AES-256 is the strongest built-in BitLocker cipher and is imperceptibly slower on modern CPUs. The policy alone does not turn BitLocker on; it only chooses the cipher used when a drive is encrypted.

managedBy.groupPolicyPath: Computer Configuration\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\BitLocker Drive Encryption\Choose drive encryption method and cipher strength (Windows 10 [Version 1511] and later)

sideEffects: Applies only to drives encrypted after the change; existing volumes keep their current cipher until they are decrypted and re-encrypted.
You must enable BitLocker yourself (this app does not run manage-bde); this policy only governs the cipher used when you do.

entries.title: Require a TPM plus startup PIN for BitLocker
entries.description: Turns on the BitLocker pre-boot authentication policy so operating-system drives require both a TPM and a startup PIN before Windows loads.
entries.rationale: A pre-boot PIN blocks DMA/cold-boot and 'evil maid' key-extraction attacks that a TPM-only configuration allows. The policy takes effect the next time BitLocker is enabled or reconfigured on the OS drive.

managedBy.groupPolicyPath: Computer Configuration\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\BitLocker Drive Encryption\Operating System Drives\Require additional authentication at startup

sideEffects: A PIN prompt appears at every boot, which breaks unattended reboots, Wake-on-LAN patching and remote management.
You must enable BitLocker yourself (this app does not run manage-bde); this policy only governs the pre-boot authentication method.

entries.title: Let the boot-start driver policy block bad drivers (ELAM)
entries.description: Sets the Early Launch Antimalware boot-start driver initialization policy to allow good, unknown and bad-but-boot-critical drivers, so known-bad boot drivers are blocked at startup.
entries.rationale: ELAM lets the anti-malware driver vet other boot-start drivers before they load, blocking known-bad rootkits. Value 3 is Microsoft's recommended setting; the stricter value 8 (good only) can prevent boot.

managedBy.groupPolicyPath: Computer Configuration\Administrative Templates\System\Early Launch Antimalware\Boot-Start Driver Initialization Policy

entries.title: Disallow S1-S3 standby to protect keys in RAM
entries.description: Disables the S1-S3 sleep (standby) power states on AC and battery, so the machine can only hibernate or shut down. Prevents encryption keys from lingering in powered RAM during sleep.
entries.rationale: Keys held in RAM during S1-S3 standby are exposed to cold-boot and DMA attacks; requiring hibernate or shutdown clears them. Modern Standby (S0 low-power idle) devices ignore this setting.

managedBy.groupPolicyPath: Computer Configuration\Administrative Templates\System\Power Management\Sleep Settings\Allow standby states (S1-S3) when sleeping (plugged in)

sideEffects: Laptops can no longer sleep and must hibernate or shut down instead, affecting battery life and resume speed.
Modern Standby (S0 low-power idle) devices ignore this policy.

entries.title: Disable Sudo for Windows
entries.description: Sets the Sudo for Windows policy to Disabled so the sudo command cannot elevate from the console. Sudo is off by default; this pins the disabled state against later changes.
entries.rationale: Sudo's inline and input-closed modes let an unelevated process drive the elevated one through the shared console, a privilege-escalation vector Microsoft documents. The 24H2 security baseline sets it Disabled.

managedBy.groupPolicyPath: Computer Configuration\Administrative Templates\System\Configure the behavior of the sudo command

sideEffects: Developers who use sudo to elevate in place lose that convenience; the forceNewWindow mode (value 1) is the safer alternative if it is required.

entries.title: Do not index encrypted files in Windows Search
entries.description: Turns off Windows Search indexing of EFS/BitLocker-encrypted files and stores so their contents are not written into the plaintext search index.
entries.rationale: Indexing encrypted items copies their content into the unencrypted search database, defeating the encryption. The STIG and Microsoft baseline require this disabled.

managedBy.groupPolicyPath: Computer Configuration\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Search\Allow indexing of encrypted files

sideEffects: Encrypted files no longer appear in Windows Search results and must be located manually.

entries.title: Block RSS enclosure downloads and clear-text feed auth
entries.description: Prevents the Windows RSS platform from automatically downloading feed enclosures (attachments) and from sending Basic authentication credentials in clear text over HTTP.
entries.rationale: Auto-downloaded enclosures are an unsolicited file-delivery path, and clear-text Basic auth over HTTP exposes credentials. Both are required off by the STIG and Microsoft baseline.

managedBy.groupPolicyPath: Computer Configuration\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\RSS Feeds\Prevent downloading of enclosures

entries.title: Disable Internet Explorer and its COM automation
entries.description: Sets the policies that block launching the retired Internet Explorer engine through COM automation and mark Internet Explorer as disabled. Edge IE mode is unaffected.
entries.rationale: The legacy MSHTML/IE engine remains a scripting and exploit surface reachable through COM automation; blocking it removes that path. DisableInternetExplorerLaunchViaCOM ships in the 25H2 baseline.

managedBy.groupPolicyPath: Computer Configuration\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Internet Explorer\Prevent launching Internet Explorer engine through COM automation

sideEffects: Legacy line-of-business apps that automate Internet Explorer through COM stop working; migrate them to Microsoft Edge IE mode.
